name: Himekishi Kainin ~Shikyuu Seifuku Keikaku~
original_name: 姫騎士壊妊～子宮征服計画～
source:
Carlo, an alchemist in the Mario Kingdom, is a capable man with great things expected of him.

However, when he is persecuted by the Princess Knight Alessandra for creating a creature of taboo, the Genome, he is run out of the country.

Several years later...

Thanks to the work of Alessandra's little sister Laura, he has a chance encounter with Alessandra. His plan is to use the princess knight as a nursery for his Genome and have her bear their children...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041450.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
马里奥王国的炼金术士卡洛是一位能干的人，所有人都对他寄予厚望。

然而，当他创造出禁忌生物“基因组”后，遭到公主骑士亚历山德拉迫害，只得被逐出国境。

几年后……

多亏亚历山德拉的妹妹劳拉，他意外与亚历山德拉重逢。他的计划是把公主骑士当作基因组的培养皿，让她生下他们的孩子……

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041450.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
